Answer: 9900 04 Jan, 2009 (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 35367 Country: India Title: Is it mandatory to have a sleep between Isha and tahajjud salah Question: Is it mandatory to have a sleep between Isha and tahajjud salah? During Ramadan people are used to awake throughout night and in the last part of night they are used to perform tahajjud salah then go for sehri, somebody said it is wrong. Answer ID: 35367 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1909/1538/B=1432) It is not necessary to sleep between Isha and Tahajjud. If someone stays awake throughout night and performs Salah al-Tahajjud before dawn, it will also be called tahajjud. It is not right to term it as wrong. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
